scope.summary: Restores the locked OraclePool public API and replaces its internal admission with a panic-safe FIFO capacity gate.
out_of_scope: Live Oracle load proof, which remains environment-gated and ignored

entry_points.name: OraclePool public API
entry_points.trace: cargo test -p oraclemcp-db pool passed 35 targeted tests, scripts/oraclemcp_api_lock.sh passed all three locks, cargo semver-checks check-release -p oraclemcp-db passed 196 checks, and hosted CI 30796274855 job 91630551164 passed API locks and semver checks.

limitations: The ignored live XE load test was not represented as a pass.
The source commit is not a whole-CI readiness claim; exact-SHA CI 30796274855 failed only the independent Windows audit-owner P0.
